hook: Load your Rats with Gossip, light one end, and watch the news blaze down the board like a fuse.
loop: Feed Gossip pips with buys, Refreshes and plays; keep runs touching.
Units at two pips form a loaded fuse along the zigzag.
One Blurt sets off a chain; each Rat pays its text.

growth.line: Small Blurt buffs every chain, multiplied at Tiers 5–6; or held pips paid out in fights.

feel.early: Quiet; Taster and Huddler land the first Blurts.
feel.mid: Wire up the fuse; Speaker, Fips and Echo shape chains.
feel.late: King's chain every turn, or Piper's all-at-once fight.

stars.why: A guaranteed full-board chain each turn; Start of Turn order matters.
Blurts at 1 and fans news out: a hub you place.
Lights the enemy's fuse; their gaps are the counterplay.

card_short.u01: Gossip from each buy; Blurt buffs it and a neighbour.
card_short.u02: When played, Gossip to itself and touching units; Blurt grows.
card_short.u03: Blurts at 2; throws Gossip to your farthest unit.
card_short.u04: Blurt: buffs the units touching it.
card_short.u05: Refreshes give it Gossip; Blurt gives gold, up to 3.
card_short.u06: Start of Turn: tops up every unit at two pips.
card_short.u07: Blurts at 1; spreads Gossip to everything next to it.
card_short.u08: Blurt: buffs every other unit holding two pips.
card_short.u09: When attacked, Gossip to itself and touching units.
card_short.u10: Blurt: grows for each unit already Blurted this chain.
card_short.u11: Touching units use their Blurt text twice.
card_short.u12: Blurt: summons a Stray beside it, twice per chain.
card_short.u13: Five-Blurt chain while recruiting: Discover a unit, once a turn.
card_short.u14: End of Turn: every unit gains stats per Gossip held.
card_short.u15: Loads enemies with Gossip; each enemy Blurt hurts them.
card_short.u16: Your other units use their Blurt text twice.
card_short.u17: Start of Turn: your whole board Blurts as one chain.
card_short.u18: Copies the Blurt text of every other unit you have.
card_short.u19: Combat start: Gossip all; Blurting units attack at once.
card_short.x01: 1/1 token with 2 Gossip; Blurt grows it.
card_short.x02: Spell: one unit Blurts now and keeps its Gossip.

builds.name: The Fuse
builds.line: Spend while recruiting: long chains, Bean-Counter last, King every turn.

builds.name: Simmer and Boil
builds.line: Hold everyone at two pips; Huddle pays, Piper sets off the fight.

builds.name: Bad Omen
builds.line: Load the enemy's board and let their own chain hurt them.

liked: News running down a seven-slot fuse plays unlike any tribe today.
Bad Omen lighting the enemy's fuse; spend-or-hold is a real choice.
worries: Watch: Piper's loaded board may make seven attacks before the enemy acts.
Watch: golden Thirty-Two runaway; Wall-Runner a free Discover each turn under King.
changed: Taster and Huddler bring their own pip, so Blurts start by turn 2-3.
Strays arrive with 2 Gossip and land touching the Tangle, re-lighting the fuse.
Rules tightened: leftover Gossip, and the Thirty-Two copies printed texts with limits.
verdict: Rated 7.3 fun, 7.7 distinct; ranked first of three Rat King designs. For combo players who love ordering puzzles.
